subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) He is considered the greatest physical after Einstein. (b) He is very skilled in Mathematics from an early age and having a brilliant result, he was able to join Cambridge University as a Lucasian professor of Mathematics. (c) In it he explains cosmology for the general public. (d) He got married in 1963. (e) He became famous and established his reputation as a great scientist. (f) He got his Ph.D in cosmology from Cambridge University by the time, he was 26 years old. (g) Stephen Hawking was born in an educated family. (h) He wrote a book, "A Brief History of Time : From the Big Bangs to the Present Times.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
